name: Purple Haze Special Thakali Thali (Non-Veg)
description: Himalayan basmati rice, tender organic local chicken curry, black lentil dal, gundruk sandeko, mustard saag, homemade radish pickle, and crispy papad.

name: Newari Samay Baji Platter
description: Beaten rice (baji), spiced barbecued buffalo choila, black soybean (bhatmas sandeko), spiced boiled potato, garlic ginger strips, marinated bamboo shoot (tama) soup, and ayla bowl.

name: Steamed Chicken Momo (10 Pcs)
description: Juicy minced chicken infused with spring onions, ginger, and aromatic Himalayan spices, served with roasted tomato-sesame achar and hot chili dip.

name: Crispy Mustang Aloo Sandeko
description: High-altitude Mustang baby potatoes pan-roasted crispy, tempered with jimbu herbs, Sichuan peppercorns (timur), mustard oil, and fresh coriander.

name: Old Delhi Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
description: Charcoal-grilled chicken tikka simmered in a silky, slow-cooked tomato makhani gravy enriched with fresh cream, butter, and dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi).

name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani (Mutton)
description: Long-grain aged basmati rice layered with succulent marinated mutton chunks, infused with saffron, caramelized onions, mint, and sealed in clay pot dum cooking. Served with burani raita and salan.

name: Paneer Lababdar & Dal Bukhara Combo
description: Cottage cheese cubes bathed in rich cashew-tomato gravy paired with 18-hour slow-cooked black urad dal, topped with churned white butter.

name: Szechuan Chicken Hakka Chowmein
description: Wok-tossed egg noodles with shredded chicken breast, bell peppers, scallions, cabbage, toasted garlic, and hot crushed Szechuan chili peppers.

name: Crispy Dragon Chilli Paneer
description: Crispy wok-glazed cottage cheese cubes tossed in spicy garlic paste, green chilies, dark soy sauce, honey, and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Wood-Fired Purple Haze Supreme Pizza
description: Hand-stretched sourdough crust with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, grilled chicken, smoked sausages, roasted bell peppers, black olives, and fresh basil.

name: Creamy Fettuccine Alfredo al Funghi
description: Italian fettuccine ribbons tossed in a velvety cream sauce with sautéed wild button mushrooms, garlic, cracked black pepper, and aged Parmigiano Reggiano.

name: Signature Purple Haze Galaxy Mocktail
description: Sparkling blue pea flower tea, fresh passion fruit puree, mint leaves, and a splash of citrus lime that swirls magically into a deep royal purple gradient.

name: Garden Fresh Mint & Lemon Mojito
description: Fresh mint plucked from our garden, muddled with brown sugar, Mexican limes, and topped with crisp effervescent soda and crushed ice.
